title: WITH RECURSIVE: Hierarchies & Sequences
description:
## WITH RECURSIVE
`WITH RECURSIVE` allows you to build queries that refer to themselves, like generating sequences or walking through hierarchies.

Example: generate numbers 1 to 10:
```sql
WITH RECURSIVE numbers(n) AS (
    SELECT 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n+1 FROM numbers WHERE n < 10
)
SELECT * FROM numbers;
```
The first SELECT is the starting point. The second SELECT refers back to itself, adding 1 each time until the condition fails.
